findings.detail: The leaf ranks metabolite features by random-forest importance, but does not compute the requested per-feature ROC/AUC, sensitivity, specificity or confidence statistics.
The leaf aggregates omics-predictor importances from metabolite regression models into a regulome network, rather than ranking metabolite biomarkers for class discrimination.
The leaf filters missing-value-heavy features, applies KNN imputation and QC-based SVR normalization, but omits the stage's blank removal, covariate-preserving batch correction and log/scaling steps.
The leaf fits PLS-DA and optional OPLS-DA models and exports VIP scores from labelled metabolomics matrices, covering the supervised component but not the requested PCA exploration.
